title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (October, 2026)
summary: Cumulative Update October 2026 for Dynamics 365 Business Central release wave 2 version 29.0 is now available in cloud and on-premises, alongside cumulative updates for earlier versions. The post provides version details, support dates, and lifecycle information for multiple BC versions from 29.x down to legacy versions.
key_points: BC 2026 release wave 2 (version 29.0) launched with platform 29.0.55365.0 and application 29.0.54011.55407
Multiple cumulative updates released: BC29 CU00, BC28 CU06, BC27 CU12, BC26 CU18 with varying build numbers
Support lifecycle shows BC29 in support until Apr 5, 2028, with earlier waves (BC28, BC27, BC26) still receiving updates
On-premises versions follow modern policy with release waves spanning April to October each year
Legacy versions BC25 and earlier are end of life
features: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in the Admin Center

quotes.text: Cumulative Update (October, 2026) for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is now released.
quotes.why_it_matters: Announces the availability of the latest cumulative update, establishing the release milestone for October 2026
Specifies exact platform and application build numbers for BC29, critical for deployment and compatibility verification
